purpose: Pinned official HadCRUT.5.2.0.0 annual global member and summary series for trend uncertainty analysis

retrieval.method: GitHub Actions workflow curl download from the Met Office official data host

license: Open Government Licence v3.0; Met Office attribution required for redistribution/use
notes: Source files are preserved byte-for-byte from the successful workflow artifact.
The ensemble member trend interval is not a frequentist confidence interval.
Additional coverage uncertainty is recorded separately and not propagated into member slope percentiles.
